question: p-solar
unit: sum (whole 30 kWp / 60 panel array mounting and structural support package)

band.unit: sum (whole 30 kWp / 60 panel array mounting and structural support package)
band.basis: Added distinct components: mounting hardware supply + mounting installation labour + supplementary purlins (supplied and fixed) + purlin bolts allowance + structural design and PS1. GST exclusive, NZD, Auckland centre. Cross-checked against Involve Energy's published 30 kW commercial band of $1,800-$2,600/kW installed (whole system incl. panels, inverter and electrical): this package at $13,000-$29,100 for 30 kWp is roughly $430-$970/kW, i.e. an appropriate share of a whole-system cost once the excluded PV modules, inverters, cabling and electrical work are taken out. Band is wide because QV publishes no solar mounting rate, the rail hardware rests on retail NZ prices scaled to commercial, the supplementary-purlin quantity is assumed at one third of footprint per the scenario, and the PS1 fee rests on a product-certification price rather than a site fee. Allowances (bolts) carry under 3% of the total, so the band is not allowance-driven. Confidence low.

band.unit: lump sum for the whole 30 kWp / 60-panel array
band.basis: Sum of distinct parts (no double counting): railing $2,020-$4,620 supply + clamps $560-$2,370 + rib brackets $570-$2,150 + minor fixings allowance $400-$900 + QV-rated install labour $2,160-$4,260 = mounting system $5,710-$14,300; plus QV proprietary purlins $1,280-$3,640 and QV bolts $570-$1,030 = strengthening $1,850-$4,670; plus structural design + PS1 $1,200-$3,000. GST exclusive, NZD, Auckland, ex preliminaries and margin. Widest uncertainty is the proprietary mounting hardware (retail small-format rails and non-penetrating clamps quoted for other roof profiles, no uplift-rated trapezoidal-sheet clamp price published) and the design fee (no NZ published PS1 rate). Confidence low. Excluded per scope: GST, prelims, margin, PV modules, inverters, cabling and all electrical work, roof sheet replacement/repair/recoating, scaffolding/edge protection/roof access, consent fees. BAND IS A COST-PLAN WORKING ESTIMATE, NOT A CERTIFIED PRICE.

band.unit: sum - whole array (30 kWp, ~60 panels, 120 m2), NZD, GST exclusive
band.basis: Additive: mounting supply $3,600-6,300 (web kit/component prices, no QV row) + mounting installation labour $2,200-3,700 (QV roofer rate $74.30/hr AKL x 30-50 person-hours) + supplementary purlins $790-1,620 (QV Proprietary Purlins rows) + purlin bolts $470-990 (QV Steelwork Bolts rows) + sundries allowance $250-600 + engineer design/PS1 $1,800-5,000 (fetched AU commercial-solar assessment figure plus stated NZ uplift for 1170.2 uplift design and PS1). Parts for a reviewer to reject independently: MOUNTING SYSTEM = $5,800-10,000 (supply + labour); STRENGTHENING = $1,260-2,610 (purlins + bolts); DESIGN/PS1 = $1,800-5,000. Cross-check: whole 30 kW commercial install in NZ is $54,000-78,000 ex GST (Involve Energy, mid-2026), so this scope at 9.1k-18.2k is a plausible 12-23% of the project. No QV row exists for the largest cost driver (proprietary solar racking) or for producer statements, hence LOW confidence: the racking is priced from Australian retail kit rates converted to NZD and NZ component lists, labour hours are estimated, and the purlin quantity derives from an assumed array geometry. Unreviewed QV rows; the band is not a certified price.
